name: Transfer list
description: A dual-list shuttle for moving items between an available column and a selected column, such as role permissions, export columns or team members. Each column supports live filtering, select-all and keyboard navigation.

classes.ayy-transfer-list: Root 3-column grid (source pane, transfer actions, target pane); stacks vertically below 48rem.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__pane: One list column card (data-pane="source" or data-pane="target").
classes.ayy-transfer-list__header: Pane top row holding the select-all checkbox, title and item count.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__title: Clickable label wrapping the pane's select-all Checkbox and heading.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__count: Tabular item count at the inline end ("2 / 6" when items are checked).
classes.ayy-transfer-list__search: Optional filter row under the header with a magnifier icon and borderless input.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__list: Scrollable list body (14rem tall) of checkable item rows.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__item: One <label> row holding an .ayy-checkbox and the item's text.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__item-body: Text column inside an item row.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__description: Optional muted second line under the item name.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__empty: Centred muted empty or no-matches message inside a pane.
classes.ayy-transfer-list__actions: Middle column (row on phones) of transfer icon buttons.

default.looks: Two surface cards with hairline headers and 14rem scrollable lists, flanking outline icon-sm transfer buttons.

hover.looks: Row gets --ayy-color-wash; transfer buttons get Button's outline hover.

pressed.none: Rows toggle their Checkbox on click; double-clicking a row transfers it right away.

focus.when: :focus-visible on a Checkbox, transfer Button or .ayy-transfer-list__filter
focus.looks: Checkboxes and buttons show their 2px --ayy-color-ring; the search row shows a 2px inset ring.

disabled.when: disabled on item Checkboxes, the filter input or transfer Buttons
disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, not-allowed cursor; transfer buttons disable automatically when nothing can move.

selected.when: :checked on an item's Checkbox (pending transfer), or presence in the target pane (assigned)
selected.looks: Checked rows get --ayy-color-wash-hover and a checked Checkbox; the header Checkbox shows indeterminate when some are checked. Forced colours: 1px Highlight outline.

error.looks: Both pane borders tint to 60% destructive. Forced colours: dashed border.

loading.none: Render Skeleton rows inside the panes while options load.

sizes.density: Header height, search bar height, checkboxes and transfer buttons follow data-density; list viewport stays 14rem tall.
sizes.width: Fills its container across two equal columns; stacks into a single column with rotated arrows below 48rem.

js: transferListClass({ className? }) → string; part class & icon SVG constants; connectTransferList(root, { onTransfer? }) → { sync, destroy }.

element.description: Wires an .ayy-transfer-list in plain HTML: moves checked rows between [data-pane="source"] and [data-pane="target"], updates counts and select-all mixed states, syncs hidden inputs when name is set, and fires ayy-change.
element.children: An .ayy-transfer-list containing source and target .ayy-transfer-list__pane elements and .ayy-transfer-list__actions.

attributes.name: Form field name: syncs one hidden input per item in the target pane.

events.ayy-change: { value: string[] } — fired whenever items move between panes.

TransferList.renders: <div role="group" class="ayy-transfer-list"> with source pane, action buttons and target pane

props.options: TransferListOption[] — id, label, description?, keywords?, disabled?
props.value / defaultValue: string[] — IDs in the target (selected) pane.
props.sourceTitle: string — heading of the available pane (default "Available").
props.targetTitle: string — heading of the selected pane (default "Selected").
props.searchable: boolean — show a filter input in each pane (default false).
props.showMoveAll: boolean — include Move all / Remove all buttons (default true).
props.sourceEmptyText: string — empty message for source pane.
props.targetEmptyText: string — empty message for target pane.
props.name: string — renders hidden inputs for selected IDs.

a11y: Every item is a real Checkbox inside a <label>, so screen readers announce its label, description and checked state natively.
ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move focus between visible checkboxes in a pane; Space toggles.
Transfer icon buttons carry descriptive aria-labels ("Move selected to Assigned") and Tooltips, and disable when no items can move.
do: Use a Transfer list when users need to see both what is available and what is assigned side by side (role permissions, report columns).
Turn on searchable when either column can hold more than ~10 items.
dont: Don't use a Transfer list to pick one or two tags in a compact form — use Record picker or Checkbox.
Don't use it for thousands of remote records — use a Data explorer table or async Record picker.
